title: The Night We Met
lyrics:
[00:30.73]I am not the only traveler
[00:38.00]Who has not repaid his debt
[00:44.21]I've been searching for a trail to follow again
[00:51.45]Take me back to the night we met
[00:58.70]And then I can tell myself
[01:05.95]What the hell I'm supposed to do
[01:13.18]And then I can tell myself
[01:20.41]Not to ride along with you
[01:27.67]I had all and then most of you, some and now none of you
[01:34.90]Take me back to the night we met
[01:42.14]I don't know what I'm supposed to do, haunted by the ghost of you
[01:49.03]Oh, take me back to the night we met
[01:56.59]When the night was full of terrors
[02:03.87]And your eyes were filled with tears
[02:11.13]When you had not touched me yet
[02:18.00]Oh, take me back to the night we met
[02:25.62]I had all and then most of you, some and now none of you
[02:32.84]Take me back to the night we met
[02:40.08]I don't know what I'm supposed to do, haunted by the ghost of you
[02:47.32]Take me back to the night we met
